title: Dragon Mania Legends Breeding Guide for Beginners | How Elements Work + 9 Dragon Combos
description: A beginner breeding guide for Dragon Mania Legends: how elements decide what you can breed, why no combination is guaranteed, how to raise your odds, and the element combos for Bee, Smoke, Ice, Lava, Dust, Snow, Tree, Clownfish and Agave dragons. Combos checked on the DML wiki and the TouchTapPlay guide.

sections.heading: How breeding works
sections.script: Welcome to this Dragon Mania Legends breeding guide for beginners. Breeding is how you fill your park with new dragons, and once you understand one simple rule, it stops feeling random. In Dragon Mania Legends you never pick the baby directly. You pick two parents, and the baby can only get elements that its parents carry. So the one rule to remember is simple: the two parents together must carry every element of the dragon you want. Some dragons carry a single element, like Fire, Wind, Earth or Water, and hybrid dragons carry two or three. The more elements your two parents bring between them, the more different babies become possible. In this video we cover the rules first, then nine dragons step by step, with the exact elements you need for each one.

sections.heading: No combination is guaranteed
sections.script: Here is the part that confuses most new players. In Dragon Mania Legends, no combination is guaranteed. The same two parents can give you different babies on different tries. That is because several dragons share the same elements, and the game picks one of the possible results each time you breed. So if you do not get the dragon you wanted on the first try, that does not mean your combination is wrong. As long as the parents carry the right elements, keep breeding, and the dragon you want can still show up. Patience is a big part of breeding in this game.

sections.heading: How to raise your odds
sections.script: You cannot force a result, but you can improve your odds. Two breeding guides agree on this tip: the higher the level of your parent dragons, and the rarer they are, the better your chances of getting a rare baby. So before you spend a long time trying for a rare dragon, level up the parents you plan to use. It also helps to keep a small set of breeding parents ready for each element, so you are never stuck waiting for the right pair. With that out of the way, let's go through the dragons one by one.

sections.heading: Bee Dragon - Fire + Wind
sections.script: The Bee Dragon carries Fire and Wind. To get it, breed two dragons that together carry Fire and Wind. Pair a Fire dragon with a Wind dragon, or use any hybrids that bring Fire and Wind between them. Keep in mind that Fire and Wind can also give you the Smoke Dragon, which needs exactly the same elements. So if a Smoke Dragon hatches, your parents are right, you just need another try. The Bee Dragon is one of the friendliest early dragons to collect.

sections.heading: Smoke Dragon - Wind + Fire
sections.script: The Smoke Dragon carries Wind and Fire. To get it, breed two dragons that together carry Wind and Fire. Yes, these are the same elements as the Bee Dragon. That makes the Smoke and Bee Dragons a good lesson in how the game works: one pair of parents, two possible babies. Breed your Wind and Fire parents, and each try gives you a chance at either one. If you want both dragons, this is the pair to keep busy in your breeding cave, because every try works toward one of them.

sections.heading: Ice Dragon - Wind + Water
sections.script: The Ice Dragon carries Wind and Water. To get it, breed two dragons that together carry Wind and Water. A Wind dragon and a Water dragon are the simplest parents. If you already own hybrids, check their elements: any two dragons that bring Wind and Water between them can work. If a different dragon hatches, that does not mean your pair is wrong. Keep the same parents, level them up, and try again.

sections.heading: Lava Dragon - Earth + Fire
sections.script: The Lava Dragon carries Earth and Fire. To get it, breed two dragons that together carry Earth and Fire. Use parents that carry Earth and Fire between them. It only needs two elements, which makes the Lava Dragon a good goal while you are still building your collection of parents. As always, no result is guaranteed, so treat each try as a chance, not a promise.

sections.heading: Dust Dragon - Wind + Earth
sections.script: The Dust Dragon carries Wind and Earth. To get it, breed two dragons that together carry Wind and Earth. Breed a Wind dragon with an Earth dragon, or two hybrids that bring Wind and Earth. The Dust Dragon is a good example of how combining two early elements already gives you a brand new dragon for your collection. If you are working on Wind dragons, it pairs well with your Ice and Bee plans, since you can keep a strong Wind parent busy for all three.

sections.heading: Snow Dragon - Water + Earth
sections.script: The Snow Dragon carries Water and Earth. To get it, breed two dragons that together carry Water and Earth. Pair a Water dragon with an Earth dragon, or hybrids that carry Water and Earth between them. If you already have a good Water parent for the Ice Dragon, you can reuse it here with an Earth partner. Reusing strong, high level parents across several goals is one of the best habits you can build in Dragon Mania Legends.

sections.heading: Tree Dragon - Earth + Plant
sections.script: The Tree Dragon carries Earth and Plant. To get it, breed two dragons that together carry Earth and Plant. Now we step into Plant dragons. Breed an Earth dragon with a Plant dragon, or hybrids that bring Earth and Plant. Plant opens up a whole new group of dragons, so once you have a Plant parent, the Tree Dragon is a natural first target. Keep the Earth parent you used for Lava and Snow, and you are ready.

sections.heading: Clownfish Dragon - Water + Earth + Wind
sections.script: The Clownfish Dragon carries Water, Earth and Wind. To get it, breed two dragons that together carry Water, Earth and Wind. This one needs three elements, so this is where hybrids really matter. Your two parents together must carry Water, Earth and Wind. For example, a parent that already has two of those elements, paired with a parent that brings the third, covers all three. Three element dragons usually take more tries, so level up those parents first.

sections.heading: Agave Dragon - Fire + Water + Plant
sections.script: The Agave Dragon carries Fire, Water and Plant. To get it, breed two dragons that together carry Fire, Water and Plant. Another three element dragon. Your parents together need Fire, Water and Plant. Plan the pair so that between them all three elements are covered, then be patient, because the more elements a dragon has, the more possible results the same parents can give. Higher level, rarer parents help a lot here.

sections.heading: Plan your parents
sections.script: Look back at the dragons we just covered and you will notice something useful. Wind shows up in Bee, Smoke, Ice, Dust and Clownfish. Earth shows up in Lava, Dust, Snow, Tree and Clownfish. Water shows up in Ice, Snow, Clownfish and Agave. So instead of chasing one dragon at a time, build a small team of strong parents: a good Wind parent, a good Earth parent, a good Water parent and a good Fire parent. Level them up, and you can point them at many different goals just by changing which two you pair together. That turns breeding from a guessing game into a plan, and it means every hour of breeding moves you toward several dragons, not just one.

sections.heading: When a different dragon hatches
sections.script: It will happen often, so let's talk about it. You set up the right parents, you wait, and a different dragon hatches. Do not change your plan straight away. First, check that your two parents really do carry every element of the dragon you want. If they do, the combination is fine, and you simply got one of the other possible results. That extra dragon is not wasted either, because it can become a parent for a future goal. Keep breeding with the same pair, and keep leveling them, because higher level parents improve your chances of a rare result over time.

sections.heading: Your breeding checklist
sections.script: Let's sum it up. One, look up the elements of the dragon you want. Two, choose two parents that together carry every one of those elements. Three, remember that no combination is guaranteed, and that dragons with the same elements, like Bee and Smoke, can hatch from the same parents. Four, level up your parents, because higher level and rarer parents improve your odds of a rare result. Which dragon do you want a guide for next? Tell me in the comments, and subscribe for more Dragon Mania Legends breeding guides.
